resources.string: Lets you freeze the current screen, tap elements to inspect their accessibility attributes, and save the result for later review.

1. Enable the service below.
2. A small bubble appears on top of every screen — drag it anywhere.
3. Tap the bubble to capture and save the current screen automatically (screenshot and full accessibility tree).
4. Open the Captured tab and pick a capture to explore it and edit which elements are selected.
5. Long-press the bubble to dismiss it; re-enable the accessibility service to bring it back.
